overview: This file documents U.S. efforts from 1946 to 1949 to supply cotton to occupied Japan, sell Japanese textiles, and repay procurement and shipping costs. Agreements and correspondence trace disputes over foreign cotton, export markets, pricing, sterling sales, agency responsibilities, and financing.
interest: The agreements and correspondence reveal how occupation policy, congressional pressure, and international trade shaped Japan’s textile recovery.
